expectedPlaces.userFacing: API danh sách và chi tiết bệnh nhân (EF Core)
Lịch hẹn hôm nay (Dapper, SQL viết tay)
Gửi nhắc lịch (minimal API, gọi stored procedure)
Trang quản trị bệnh nhân (/Admin/Patients, Razor Pages)

traps.what: controller routes use [Route("api/[controller]")] tokens and {id:int} constraints
callers go through the IPatientService interface (DI), not the class name
Dapper repository joins Patients by hand and forgets the IsDeleted filter used elsewhere
stored procedure usp_PatientContacts reads Patients.Phone; minimal API calls it by name
Invoices.AppointmentRef holds an appointment id without a foreign key
Angular builds URLs from environment.apiUrl and a service base field
connection string lives in appsettings.Development.json in ADO.NET format
